movelist.name: Ingrain
movelist.effect: Ingrain applies a Coat to the user, which has the following effect; the user cannot be pushed or pulled, and cannot be switched out.  At the beginning of each of the user’s turn, the user gains a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Bind
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

abilities.name: Flying Fly Trap
abilities.effect: The Pokémon takes no damage from Ground Type Moves and Bug Type Moves. Defensive.

abilities.name: Weird Power
abilities.effect: If the user’s Attack is higher than its Special Attack, the user may add its Attack Stat to its Special Damage Rolls. If their Special Attack is higher, they user may add its Special Attack Stat to its Physical Damage Rolls. This does not stack with Mixed Power.
